Detected build system: none
Detected commands: none

Merge policy:
  verify parks every passing PR for boss pr approve or the TUI's [m]erge.
  To enable auto-merge, remove the "**" entry from
  verifyDefaults.alwaysHumanPaths and merge that change to the base
  branch.
  commit .boss-skills.json and merge it to the base branch before the
  first build: verify reads its park-every-PR policy from there, and until
  then it merges passing PRs

Blocks skipped (not written; the built-in defaults supply them):
  trackerConfig
    LINEAR_API_KEY is not set, so no Linear teams were listed and no team is
    pinned; the skills still auto-detect the team at run time when exactly
    one is visible to the tracker MCP server; or re-run with --team <name>
  adapters, planStorage, planContract
    not detectable from a repo's files; the built-in defaults supply it when
    the config is loaded
  review
    which review a repo runs is an operator choice, not a property of its
    files; the built-in review with its cross-agent second model applies
    until an operator names a replacement review skill
  reviewDefaults
    not detectable from a repo's files; the built-in defaults supply it when
    the config is loaded
  planDependencies
    which shared files every ticket appends to is a fact about this repo's
    history, not its files; the built-in block is empty and the dependency
    scan uses only its per-run payload until an operator declares them
  epicDefaults
    how long a child of an epic typically runs is a fact about this repo's
    work, not about its files, so it cannot be detected; the built-in child
    wall clock applies until an operator measures otherwise
  notesDefaults
    a reporting-cadence preference rather than a repository property; the
    built-in default runs the post-terminal notes phase (and the pre-PR
    knowledge phase) on every run, and an operator who wants fewer of them
    declares the block and turns sampleRate down
  extensionRoots
    not detectable from a repo's files; the built-in defaults scan the
    supported agent skill roots
  env
    describes the harness a skill runs under, not the repository; the
    built-in headless-detection signals apply unchanged
  publishConfig
    empty by default and validated only per existing entry, so writing an
    empty block would add nothing the defaults do not already supply

Harness MCP declarations (not written; these files belong to the harness).
If you add a trackerConfig, declare its MCP server to each harness you use:
  Claude Code -> .mcp.json
    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "<mcpServer>": {
          "type": "http",
          "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp",
          "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${TRACKER_API_KEY}" }
        }
      }
    }
  Codex -> .codex/config.toml
    [mcp_servers."<mcpServer>"]
    url = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
    bearer_token_env_var = "TRACKER_API_KEY"
    required = false
  Use the trackerConfig.<tracker>.mcpServer name from .boss-skills.json as the server
  key above. The skills also resolve the server under another spelling or name, as
  long as it publishes the tracker's tools.
